The available shared workbook audit reports:

- **45 actual controls**, excluding headings, guidance, and other non-control lines.
- **23 complete; 22 incomplete — 51.1% completion.**
- **10 incomplete controls are Critical priority.**

**Blocked controls**

| Control ID | Relocated service |
|---|---|
| WF-030 | Pulmonary |
| WF-032 | Pulmonary |
| WF-036 | General Surgery |

**Verification caveat:** I independently reviewed 23 controls. Supporting rows were access-restricted, so the full-workbook figures and blocker list above rely on the shared audit rather than complete independent verification. No workbook data were changed.
